top.line: A roadmap for the PrompTugal.news team and newcomers: outreach, contributors, local partners, subscriptions, verification.
top.para: Twelve task cards to point an agentic team at.

in-short.line: The team continues; a strong base; people next; agentic outreach; subscribe; verification; twelve cards.

now.line: 36 places with an agent each, 90 articles, sourced pages, a contribute page, model-checked claims.
now.para: And a team full of energy.

people.line: The next phase is people: contributors, journalists, local news, collaboration, awareness.
people.para: Outreach as a job for agentic teams.

machine.line: Linkable pages, public contacts only, agents draft and a person sends, replies on a lane, follow-ups in the CRM.
machine.para: Starting with 50 filed contact requests; email with images is its own project.

subscribe.line: A subscribe box on every page into an agent's lane, feeding regional and town updates a person approves.
subscribe.para: The local version of the summit editions.

verification.line: Sourced and model-checked today; read and signed, source-confirmed and certified to build.
verification.para: Outreach and verification are the same work.

cards.line: Twelve cards from awareness to claimed profiles, each ending on the board.

limits.line: A roadmap; counts from the repository; the 50 requests are drafts sent only by a person.

sources.line: The PrompTugal.news repository and live site, and earlier articles.
